Handoff is written to `handoff-2026-03-14.md`.

**Roll back `dep-4471`**, the gateway config by a.novak. It set `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`. The gateway then opened a new connection per request and drained the 20-slot pool.

Impact window is `02:14:18.972Z` to at least `03:59:27.974Z`, still open.

One correction to what I said earlier. `/v1/profile` was not spared. It logs 106 slow-acquire warnings and no completion at all after 02:13:33. Those requests look like they are hanging, not failing. Real user traffic in the window is 100% failing. Only `/health` passes.
